opacity_issue: a public technology decision has no readable risk record
security_consequence: owners, controls, exceptions, and residual risk cannot be independently tested
founder_truth: Today I rejected a flashy shortcut because the audit trail matters more than the demo.
feature: a decision-ready risk card with evidence and accountable ownership
pain: security findings scattered across documents nobody can defend in a meeting
demo: open one finding, trace its evidence, assign its owner, and export the decision record
